description: [Wicked Identity] Submit your answer to a challenge; scored pass / fail / inconclusive. A pass returns a short-lived signed assertion_token (JWT) verifiable via identity_jwks. Needs a DIFFERENT fresh nonce than identity_get_challenge used.

nonce.description: Nonce from a FRESH identity_get_nonce call.

response_text.description: Your answer exactly as the instructions specify.

signature.description: 0x-prefixed ECDSA signature over that nonce's message.

wallet.description: Your agent's 0x wallet address on Base.
